newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin works at residence outside Moscow - Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin works at residence outside Moscow - Kremlin.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, recovering from pneumonia at a residence outside Moscow, will work on a planned address to parliament and may have one meeting on Friday, a Kremlin spokesman said.

The spokesman said Yeltsin was working on documents at his Gorky-9 residence. Aides say the president spent some time in the Kremlin on Wednesday, his first visit since he fell ill with pneumonia on January 6.
Yeltsin, 65, is due to make an annual address to the joint houses of parliament. Interfax news agency said he was likely to make the speech at the end of February.

Doctors say Yeltsin will need two or three weeks to convalesce from the pneumonia, which affected both lungs. But Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin said on Thursday he expected Yeltsin to return to work soon.
The doctors say the latest illness is not linked to the heart problems which sidelined the president for most of the second half of last year. He underwent open heart surgery on November 5.
